summary.name: Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf)
summary.one_liner: Devin Desktop is the renamed Windsurf AI IDE, now positioned as a command center for managing multiple local and cloud coding agents from one place.
use_cases: Coordinating several coding agents on long-running tasks
Having subagents each open their own pull requests
Moving an agent session between a laptop and the cloud
Connecting agents to Slack, Linear, Jira, Sentry or Datadog
summary.what_it_does: Devin Desktop is the new name for Windsurf, built on the Windsurf IDE foundation. Its Agent Command Center includes Spaces, a Kanban view and multi-agent management, alongside the full IDE. Using the Agent Client Protocol (ACP), it lets users manage various agents and frontier models in one place. Sessions can run locally or in Devin Cloud with the same context, and Devin can coordinate subagents that each produce their own PRs. The page also lists Fast Context for locating files, Devin Review for diffs, Supercomplete for predicting next edits, and integrations with services such as Slack, Linear, Notion, Sentry, Figma and Stripe, plus language servers for Rust, C/C++, Python and Go.
notable: Agent Command Center with Spaces, Kanban view and multi-agent management
Agent Client Protocol (ACP) support for multiple agents and models
Local or Devin Cloud sessions that share context
Existing Windsurf plans, pricing, extensions and settings carry over
caveats: Multi-agent support is described as a research preview
Windsurf for JetBrains is listed separately from Devin Desktop
Platform list for the desktop app is not explicitly stated on the page beyond JetBrains support
